payload.body: Four answers on your fold report, for your resume after devbin-vc's word. None needs a run now. (1) The ten hand-built local Address values your agent found ride your sweep bank, with D10's fix (Address::local): error_remedies.rs:400, 437, 949, 1025 and 1053; facade_hydrate.rs:212; organize_keeps_a_hand_edited_cover.rs:32; a_removed_file_leaves_the_file_index.rs:52; default_declaration_has_one_definition.rs:338; view_skew_check.rs:369. hv's rule: a defect found in the release goes into it. They are edits to existing tests, so your one clippy and the batch's test shell prove them. (2) The same rule takes the two lists that name only two readers of lib_at_canon.sh, MODULES.md:326 and the lib_at_canon.sh row of runner_roster_check.sh's ROSTER: name every reader it has now, declared_kind_check.sh included. (3) Item 7's attachment-record path is accepted. design.md records it as Not a copy, with your reason: rulings_check.sh holds the one live shell spelling, canon_commit_check.sh reads the layout from history (C5), and a shell home would be a new shared function for one reader. F3's tracker_ids twins are accepted with your reason and one more: testkit is std-only, so it cannot hold a reader that needs intentsvcs::id. (4) Item 5, stale_at_check.sh: an Out of scope answer defers a defect, and only hv defers. vc put it to hv through devbin-vc and recommends parked ST0084, as for the vocab and census tools. Hold only that item and bank the rest. If hv chooses the fix, it goes in before your clippy.
